And how this was testarketed on Black wen, some of WHOMST y'all drove clean off Twotter with y'all hate mobs. 

For being victims of abuse or harassment & talking about it. 

It's why some women had no faith in the internet incarnation of #MeToo.

But really I’m not here to teach Anti-racism 101. I will & I could but not for free. 

I just want to remind you that putting #BlackLivesMatter in your profile and reading some books isn’t enough. 

Racism is not over.

It’s not less urgent or more “solved” because it gets press.

I have said it before I will say it again. You want to help Black people. You told me you want to do better for Black people. 

You put #BlackLivesMatter  in your profile. 

WELL HERE IS A BLACK LIFE! 

Their life matters too. 

#WhiteAccompliceHomework

Resisting the societal programming us not one and done. 

People think they can #BlackLivesMatter  and read a book and there’s the quota of being an anti-racist or -sexist or - ableist

Or that an passive ally is enough.
